title: Figurines against unknown witchcraft

dating.label: Middle Assyrian · Middle Babylonian · Neo-Assyrian witnesses
dating.note: Surviving witnesses carry Middle Assyrian, Middle Babylonian and Neo-Assyrian labels. These date witnesses, not the original composition or performance.

purpose: Make, burn and discard figurines representing an unknown warlock and witch.
attribution: Practitioner unspecified in the edited instructions

phases.name: Prepare the figures
phases.idea: The accused are represented by figures, presented and coated.

phases.name: Destroy and address
phases.idea: The figures are placed in a pot, burned and addressed to Šamaš.

phases.name: Discard the remains
phases.idea: The burnt material is removed to the river.
